source_review: English text checked against source frames. Navigation timestamps are approximate.
speaker_policy: Preserve labels visible on screen; Stranger → Yabancı, Cop → Polis; keep personal names unchanged. Do not invent labels on unlabelled replies.
translation_style: Natural spoken Turkish; preserve humour, intent, slang and profanity without adding new meaning.
completion_scope: Readable subtitle candidates from the full 2 fps video scan, with visible speaker labels; includes a few fully visible phone messages. Not a translation of all menus, world text or clipped notifications.
coverage: Full video sampled at 2 fps; distinct readable subtitle candidates visually checked and translated. One source-censored caption omitted. Sampling can miss short captions; SRT times are approximate.
